task_name: Relocate Polluting Coal Power Plant Away from Residential Neighborhood

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When residential homes near the Coal Power Plant show yellow unhappiness faces and red complaint bubbles ('That power plant is loud and dirty!'), dragging city happiness down to 82%.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Moving the Coal Power Plant to the far northern industrial road removes its pollution radius from the homes, restoring citizen happiness and fulfilling the 'Happy City' journal requirement.
preconditions: Distant road connected to the city grid
Free space next to the new factories on the northern road
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Tap and hold the Coal Power Plant and drag it next to the factories on the northernmost road so its brown pollution zone does not touch any residential buildings.

steps.who: Coal Power Plant (tap and hold to pick up)
steps.briefing: drag the Coal Power Plant from the residential street to the far northern road beside the two new Small Factories.
confirm the new location of the Coal Power Plant.

steps.who: floating Metal icons on the two northern Small Factories

steps.briefing: drag Metal into all empty production slots.
